title: There's a parasite hiding in your salad bag right now
text:
There's a parasite hiding in your salad bag right now, and washing it won't help.

Cyclospora is a microscopic parasite that survives on fresh produce even after rinsing, and outbreaks tied to bagged salad kits have sickened people across Michigan, Indiana, and several other states this month. Symptoms can take a full week to appear, and health officials say some contaminated product may already be in your refrigerator.

Check your bag against the recall list before you eat another bite.
